name: FifoRosterTravelPlanner
tagline: FIFO/DIDO swings, charter manifests, camp rooms and POB in one plug-and-play Power Platform app.
description: A complete fly-in fly-out workforce app for mine sites: plan swings by crew and roster pattern, check fatigue and R&R rules, build charter flight manifests against seat allocations, allocate camp rooms without double bookings, approve roster swaps and watch people on board – in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: POB, arrivals, departures and camp occupancy KPIs
Drag-to-move swings with fatigue, R&R and room rules
Charter manifests with overbooking flags and suggested flights
Camp room board with clash detection and auto-assign
Demo mode with fictional sample data
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
